title: Hatsune Miku — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone! Thanks for waiting!
Miku's anniversary show is about to start!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone watching the stream, can you hear us alright?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's starting!>
<Oh my gosh, I'm so excited!!!>
<We can hear you!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But, this is strange. Aren't we missing someone?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, don't you know the heroine always arrives just in the nick of time?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright then, for everyone in the audience and on stream, let's call the star of the day!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sorry for keeping you waiting, everyone! Let's start the anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This will be our first song! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I hope you enjoyed the first song♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since everyone's here, let's wish Miku a happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys! Are you ready?!
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! It was like one big chorus of anniversary wishes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So the thing is, I have a theme for today's show. The theme is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even now, I have all these feelings of gratitude overflowing in my heart...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I want to express those feelings in song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to sing with all my heart, so I hope you enjoy it to the very end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We'll also be right there singing with you, to help you get those feelings across.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's make this the best day ever, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, here's our next song!
Please do the honors, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And for asking an encore too...
I'm so happy to be able to sing all these songs for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Last but not least, I hope you'll accept our feelings of gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you for letting me be a part of this really fun show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's continue to reach people with our songs this year as well. Love you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just from singing together, I can feel just how much of your heart you put in when you sing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You inspire me to always do more and better. Thank you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even though it was your anniversary, it made me happy when you asked for my opinion and how I wanted to sing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was also really happy when you took my ideas into consideration, too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's your anniversary show and yet, even as the star of the day, you made sure to make it an enjoyable one for everyone else, and saw it through to the end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for letting me be a part of this really great anniversary show! You truly did amazing today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And to everyone who came here and those tuning in to the stream...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please let me say it once again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm able to sing like this because you're all here to listen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for depending on me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So that you'll never feel lonely... So that you can all shine...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope you'll let me stay by your side.
